entries.label: TELL_US_ABOUT_WORLD
entries.body:
Your suggestion is appropriate.
Acceptable new worlds are a priority for the rapid and complete spread of Juffo-Wup.
We wish to know more for our suitability assessment.
Tell us of this world.
entries.source:
Your suggestion is appropriate.
Acceptable new worlds are a priority for the rapid and complete spread of Juffo-Wup.
We wish to know more for our suitability assessment.
Tell us of this world.
entries.translation:
你的提議很合適。
適宜的新世界， 是朱佛－烏普迅速而完整擴 展的首要目標。
為了評估其適用性， 我們希望知道更多。
告訴我們這個世界的情況。

entries.label: BYE_AND_DIE_HOMEWORLD
entries.body:
You impede the flow of Juffo-Wup through the Universe.
We will now remove this clog.
We will now aid Juffo-Wup by eliminating you!
entries.source:
You impede the flow of Juffo-Wup through the Universe.
We will now remove this clog.
We will now aid Juffo-Wup by eliminating you!
entries.translation:
你阻礙了朱佛－烏普流遍宇 宙。
我們現在就要清除這道阻 塞。
我們現在就以消滅你來協助 朱佛－烏普！

entries.label: RAMBLE_1
entries.body:
A single spore lands, finds nourishment in decay and soon attains maturity..
In turn it exhales a cloud of new life, a thousand spores, each lands, finds nourishment in decay
so progresses Juffo-Wup.
entries.source:
A single spore lands, finds nourishment in decay and soon attains maturity..
In turn it exhales a cloud of new life, a thousand spores, each lands, finds nourishment in decay
so progresses Juffo-Wup.
entries.translation:
一枚孢子落地， 在腐朽中汲取養分， 不久便告成熟……
接著，它吐出一團新生命之 雲；千枚孢子各自落地， 在腐朽中汲取養分
朱佛－烏普就此推進。

entries.label: RAMBLE_2
entries.body:
Our bodies seethe with the passion of our genes.
A thousand of your species do not possess the richness in one of my cells.
entries.source:
Our bodies seethe with the passion of our genes.
A thousand of your species do not possess the richness in one of my cells.
entries.translation:
我們的軀體因基因的激情而 沸騰。
你們物種的一千個個體， 也不及我一枚細胞豐饒。

entries.label: RAMBLE_3
entries.body:
I fill with my parents parents parents parents parents
I am they -- and they are us. Then, and now.
entries.source:
I fill with my parents parents parents parents parents
I am they -- and they are us. Then, and now.
entries.translation:
我體內充滿親代、 親代的親代、親代的親代的 親代、親代的親代的親代的 親代、親代的親代的親代的 親代的親代
我就是他們——而他們就是 我們。昔日如此， 今亦如此。

entries.label: RAMBLE_4
entries.body:
The Deep Children are part of Juffo-Wup -- home builders.
The dwellers in the Mohorovichic.
entries.source:
The Deep Children are part of Juffo-Wup -- home builders.
The dwellers in the Mohorovichic.
entries.translation:
深淵之子是朱佛－烏普的一 部分——家園的建造者。
莫霍洛維奇層的棲居者。

entries.label: RAMBLE_5
entries.body:
I am Dugee
I am the purity monitor
I choose what buds are permitted to mature.
and which must be eradicated.
I died of general misfunction 57,283 years ago.
entries.source:
I am Dugee
I am the purity monitor
I choose what buds are permitted to mature.
and which must be eradicated.
I died of general misfunction 57,283 years ago.
entries.translation:
我是 Dugee
我是純度監察者
我決定哪些新芽獲准成熟。
以及哪些必須根除。
我在 57,283 年前死於全身性故障。

entries.label: RAMBLE_6
entries.body: A cold rock, spinning silently in the Void, a womb for the Children.
entries.source: A cold rock, spinning silently in the Void, a womb for the Children.
entries.translation: 一顆冰冷的岩石， 在虛空中無聲旋轉， 是子嗣的母胎。

entries.label: RAMBLE_7
entries.body:
Pulsing hot liquid flows through my outstretched tendrils, sending thrills into my interior.
The moment has come. I swell and burst.
Above me a cloud of whispering life whirls through the air.
I am content.
entries.source:
Pulsing hot liquid flows through my outstretched tendrils, sending thrills into my interior.
The moment has come. I swell and burst.
Above me a cloud of whispering life whirls through the air.
I am content.
entries.translation:
脈動的炙熱液體流過我伸展 的卷鬚，陣陣快感直入體 內。
時刻已至。我膨脹， 然後迸裂。
在我上方，一團低語的生命 之雲旋舞於空中。
我已滿足。

entries.label: RAMBLE_8
entries.body: The Juffo-Wup is strong in this place.
entries.source: The Juffo-Wup is strong in this place.
entries.translation: 此地的朱佛－烏普十分強 盛。

entries.label: RAMBLE_9
entries.body:
Your simple sexual process produces random mosaics of genetic instructions
yet with the simplicity of breath, I modify my own patterns.
You humans improve a tool and double your capabilities.
We Mycon improve ourselves and increase a thousand-fold.
entries.source:
Your simple sexual process produces random mosaics of genetic instructions
yet with the simplicity of breath, I modify my own patterns.
You humans improve a tool and double your capabilities.
We Mycon improve ourselves and increase a thousand-fold.
entries.translation:
你們簡陋的有性生殖會產生 隨機拼接的遺傳指令
而我只消呼吸般輕易， 便能修改自身模式。
你們人類改良一件工具， 能力便增為兩倍。
我們邁康改良自身， 能力便增為千倍。

entries.label: RAMBLE_10
entries.body:
The Deep Children!
Spears of light in the darkness! 
Their discarded husks speak of joy to come.
entries.source:
The Deep Children!
Spears of light in the darkness! 
Their discarded husks speak of joy to come.
entries.translation:
深淵之子！
黑暗中的光之長矛！ 
他們拋棄的空殼， 訴說著即將降臨的喜悅。

entries.label: RAMBLE_11
entries.body:
I have chosen my offsprings' memories carefully from my set of remembrances
the sweet and warm times of my existence and those of my parents parents parents
the bits of a million lifetimes coalesced into a birth gift of complete awareness.
entries.source:
I have chosen my offsprings' memories carefully from my set of remembrances
the sweet and warm times of my existence and those of my parents parents parents
the bits of a million lifetimes coalesced into a birth gift of complete awareness.
entries.translation:
我從自己的記憶集裡， 仔細挑選了子代的記憶
有我存在時甜美溫暖的歲 月，也有親代、 親代的親代、親代的親代的 親代的歲月
百萬段生命的碎片凝聚成一 份誕生禮物：完整的認知。

entries.label: RAMBLE_12
entries.body:
In the dark they grow, the deep fire feeds the Children.
Their birth breathes warmth across a cold world.
entries.source:
In the dark they grow, the deep fire feeds the Children.
Their birth breathes warmth across a cold world.
entries.translation:
他們在黑暗中成長， 深處烈火哺育著子嗣。
他們的誕生，將暖意吹遍冰 冷世界。

entries.label: RAMBLE_13
entries.body: `...the system requires more energy. A convenient source lies beneath the crust...'
entries.source: `...the system requires more energy. A convenient source lies beneath the crust...'
entries.translation: `……系統需要更多能量。 地殼下方有一個便利的來 源……'

entries.label: RAMBLE_14
entries.body:
We look to Juffo-Wup for direction, and it provides the pattern
endless expansion with purity of achievement and intolerance of error.
entries.source:
We look to Juffo-Wup for direction, and it provides the pattern
endless expansion with purity of achievement and intolerance of error.
entries.translation:
我們仰望朱佛－烏普指引方 向，而它賜下模式
無盡擴展，成就純粹， 絕不容忍錯誤。

entries.label: RAMBLE_15
entries.body:
I am Shloosh
I was incinerated fourteen thousand Earth years ago
I live now, for but a moment
and then, I am gone.
entries.source:
I am Shloosh
I was incinerated fourteen thousand Earth years ago
I live now, for but a moment
and then, I am gone.
entries.translation:
我是 Shloosh
我在一萬四千個地球年前被 焚為灰燼
此刻我再度活著， 卻只有片刻
接著，我便消逝。

entries.label: RAMBLE_16
entries.body: `...incorporation of dense amphibole fibers ensure survival in environmental extremes...'
entries.source: `...incorporation of dense amphibole fibers ensure survival in environmental extremes...'
entries.translation: `……加入高密度角閃石纖 維，可確保在極端環境中存 活……'

entries.label: RAMBLE_17
entries.body:
I yearn for magma
the flowing warm basalts
the red glow of the lava pools.
entries.source:
I yearn for magma
the flowing warm basalts
the red glow of the lava pools.
entries.translation:
我渴望岩漿
流動而溫暖的玄武岩
熔岩池的赤紅光芒。

entries.label: RAMBLE_18
entries.body: When we encounter the Non, we must absorb the Non or reject the Non so that it is no longer Non.
entries.source: When we encounter the Non, we must absorb the Non or reject the Non so that it is no longer Non.
entries.translation: 當我們遭遇非者， 便須吸收非者， 或排斥非者，使其不再為非 者。

entries.label: RAMBLE_19
entries.body: `...entry of noise into the signal is unavoidable. We must include a filtering mechanism...'
entries.source: `...entry of noise into the signal is unavoidable. We must include a filtering mechanism...'
entries.translation: `……雜訊進入訊號無可避 免。我們必須加入過濾機 制……'

entries.label: RAMBLE_20
entries.body:
Cessation of an individual is unavoidable
a consequence of existence
yet with the birth of life, individuality is transferred in part
and may occasionally gain dominance for an interval
achieving a kind of shared immortality.
entries.source:
Cessation of an individual is unavoidable
a consequence of existence
yet with the birth of life, individuality is transferred in part
and may occasionally gain dominance for an interval
achieving a kind of shared immortality.
entries.translation:
個體的終止無可避免
那是存在的後果
然而，生命誕生時， 個體性會有一部分隨之傳遞
偶爾還能在一段時間內占據 主導
成就某種共有的不朽。

entries.label: RAMBLE_21
entries.body: `...Survival is a priority. Expansion is a priority. Processing is a priority...'
entries.source: `...Survival is a priority. Expansion is a priority. Processing is a priority...'
entries.translation: `……生存優先。 擴展優先。處理優先……'

entries.label: RAMBLE_22
entries.body:
Juffo-Wup acknowledges the existence of un-Voidable Non
when we are faced with such, we join, absorb and wait for our opportunity
to learn the weakness that will allow us to Void the Non.
entries.source:
Juffo-Wup acknowledges the existence of un-Voidable Non
when we are faced with such, we join, absorb and wait for our opportunity
to learn the weakness that will allow us to Void the Non.
entries.translation:
朱佛－烏普承認無法歸虛之 非者的存在
面對這類存在時， 我們會加入、吸收， 靜待時機
找出能讓我們使非者歸虛的 弱點。

entries.label: RAMBLE_23
entries.body:
At times, I meet another, who shares with me the life of a parent inside the mind
and if we speak this fragment becomes predominant in the both of us
and self meets self with occasionally enlightening results.
entries.source:
At times, I meet another, who shares with me the life of a parent inside the mind
and if we speak this fragment becomes predominant in the both of us
and self meets self with occasionally enlightening results.
entries.translation:
有時，我會遇見另一個個 體；在心智深處， 他與我共有一位親代的生命
若我們交談，這段碎片便會 在我倆體內占據主導
自我與自我相逢， 偶爾會帶來啟迪。

entries.label: RAMBLE_24
entries.body:
The Podships thrum with the plasma containment field
whose offspring seek to transform the Non to Void
the fields grow tighter, and tighter
the bass rumble of the generators rises gradually to a high burning scream
sudden silence and a flash of light announce release
the hot pulsing subsides slowly.
entries.source:
The Podships thrum with the plasma containment field
whose offspring seek to transform the Non to Void
the fields grow tighter, and tighter
the bass rumble of the generators rises gradually to a high burning scream
sudden silence and a flash of light announce release
the hot pulsing subsides slowly.
entries.translation:
孢子艦隨著電漿圍阻場低鳴
它的子代試圖把非者化為虛 空
場域越收越緊，越收越緊
發電機的低沉轟響逐漸升為 灼熱尖嘯
驟然的寂靜與一道閃光宣告 釋放
炙熱脈動緩緩平息。

entries.label: RAMBLE_25
entries.body:
The Deep Children fall from the Void, gathering speed for the penetration
The tough casing warms as it passes through the atmosphere, glowing white as it hits the surface
solid rock flows like liquid, and the child slips into the warm, safe depths beneath the crust.
entries.source:
The Deep Children fall from the Void, gathering speed for the penetration
The tough casing warms as it passes through the atmosphere, glowing white as it hits the surface
solid rock flows like liquid, and the child slips into the warm, safe depths beneath the crust.
entries.translation:
深淵之子自虛空墜落， 不斷加速以求貫入
堅韌外殼穿過大氣時逐漸升 溫，撞上地表時已熾白發亮
堅岩如液體般流動， 子嗣滑入地殼下溫暖安全的 深處。

entries.label: RAMBLE_26
entries.body: `...look... think... act... look... learn... remember... teach... repeat...'
entries.source: `...look... think... act... look... learn... remember... teach... repeat...'
entries.translation: `……觀察……思考…… 行動……觀察……學習…… 記憶……教導……重複…… '

entries.label: RAMBLE_27
entries.body:
The implantation fleet has assembled in orbit above the green world
the patterns of weakness reveal the point of introduction.
The Child is prepared for its birthing trip.
Release!
entries.source:
The implantation fleet has assembled in orbit above the green world
the patterns of weakness reveal the point of introduction.
The Child is prepared for its birthing trip.
Release!
entries.translation:
植入艦隊已在綠色世界上方 的軌道集結
弱點的模式揭示了引入點。
子嗣已準備好踏上誕生之 旅。
釋放！

entries.label: RAMBLE_28
entries.body:
I am Gussh
I attend the birthing nodes
I died 343 Earth years ago
I do not know how.
entries.source:
I am Gussh
I attend the birthing nodes
I died 343 Earth years ago
I do not know how.
entries.translation:
我是 Gussh
我照料誕生節點
我在 343 個地球年前死去
我不知道原因。

entries.label: RAMBLE_29
entries.body:
When Juffo-Wup is complete
when at last there is no Void, no Non
when the Creators return
then we can finally rest.
entries.source:
When Juffo-Wup is complete
when at last there is no Void, no Non
when the Creators return
then we can finally rest.
entries.translation:
當朱佛－烏普完整之時
當虛空與非者終於不復存在 之時
當創造者歸來之時
我們終能安息。

entries.label: RAMBLE_30
entries.body:
Darkness is Void
Juffo-Wup is light.
entries.source:
Darkness is Void
Juffo-Wup is light.
entries.translation:
黑暗即虛空
朱佛－烏普即光。

entries.label: RAMBLE_31
entries.body: `... planetary transformer biot 94-18: take your place at the transporter dais...'
entries.source: `... planetary transformer biot 94-18: take your place at the transporter dais...'
entries.translation: `……行星改造生化機器體 94-18：前往傳送台就 位……'

entries.label: RAMBLE_32
entries.body: You are the Non. You must go now, and never return.
entries.source: You are the Non. You must go now, and never return.
entries.translation: 你就是非者。你必須立刻離 開，永不返回。

entries.label: question_1
entries.body: What can you tell me about your species?
entries.source: What can you tell me about your species?
entries.translation: 你們能告訴我哪些關於自身 物種的事？

entries.label: question_2
entries.body: Well then, what can you tell us of your history?
entries.source: Well then, what can you tell us of your history?
entries.translation: 那麼，你們能說說自己的歷 史嗎？

entries.label: question_3
entries.body: Why are you unwilling to address my questions?
entries.source: Why are you unwilling to address my questions?
entries.translation: 你們為何不願回答我的問 題？

entries.label: question_4
entries.body: You're not paying any attention to me, are you?
entries.source: You're not paying any attention to me, are you?
entries.translation: 你根本沒在聽我說話， 對吧？

entries.label: bye_space
entries.body: Don't trouble yourself. I'll see myself out.
entries.source: Don't trouble yourself. I'll see myself out.
entries.translation: 不勞費心。我自己會出去。

entries.label: BYE_AND_DIE_SPACE
entries.body: Juffo-Wup fills in my fibers and I grow turgid. Violent action ensues.
entries.source: Juffo-Wup fills in my fibers and I grow turgid. Violent action ensues.
entries.translation: 朱佛－烏普充盈我的纖維， 我變得飽滿膨脹。 暴力行動隨之而來。

entries.label: gonna_die
entries.body: Time to die.
entries.source: Time to die.
entries.translation: 受死吧。

entries.label: insult_1
entries.body: I wonder how you would taste, fried in butter?
entries.source: I wonder how you would taste, fried in butter?
entries.translation: 我倒想知道，把你裹上奶油 煎熟會是什麼味道？

entries.label: insult_2
entries.body: You know, I probably have some of your relatives between my toes!
entries.source: You know, I probably have some of your relatives between my toes!
entries.translation: 你知道嗎，我腳趾縫裡搞不 好還夾著幾個你的親戚！

entries.label: insult_3
entries.body: Is that a rock you're sitting on, or do you just have a big butt?
entries.source: Is that a rock you're sitting on, or do you just have a big butt?
entries.translation: 你坐的是塊岩石， 還是你的屁股就是那麼大？

entries.label: insult_4
entries.body: I don't suppose there's a chance that you'll actually respond to what I am saying, is there?
entries.source: I don't suppose there's a chance that you'll actually respond to what I am saying, is there?
entries.translation: 你大概根本不可能回應我說 的話，對吧？

entries.label: insult_5
entries.body: I can't believe I'm trying to have a conversation with a hot fungus.
entries.source: I can't believe I'm trying to have a conversation with a hot fungus.
entries.translation: 真不敢相信，我居然想跟一 朵燙呼呼的真菌聊天。

entries.label: insult_6
entries.body: Stop wiggling those... those... whatever they are!
entries.source: Stop wiggling those... those... whatever they are!
entries.translation: 別再扭那些……那些…… 管它是什麼的東西了！

entries.label: insult_7
entries.body: Where's the Absorbing Junior when you need it?
entries.source: Where's the Absorbing Junior when you need it?
entries.translation: 需要「吸力小子」時， 它偏偏跑哪去了？

entries.label: insult_8
entries.body: Helloo? Ugly! Can you hear me?
entries.source: Helloo? Ugly! Can you hear me?
entries.translation: 喂——？醜八怪！ 聽得到嗎？

entries.label: come_in_peace
entries.body: Mycon. Please try to understand. We wish peace between our peoples.
entries.source: Mycon. Please try to understand. We wish peace between our peoples.
entries.translation: 邁康，請試著理解。 我們希望彼此的人民能和平 共處。

entries.label: HELLO_HOMEWORLD_1
entries.body:
Juffo-Wup is All... omni-existent, spreading and changing the Non into Juffo-Wup.
You are Non, who must become Juffo-Wup or Void.
We are the agents of Juffo-Wup.
We are the Mycon.
entries.source:
Juffo-Wup is All... omni-existent, spreading and changing the Non into Juffo-Wup.
You are Non, who must become Juffo-Wup or Void.
We are the agents of Juffo-Wup.
We are the Mycon.
entries.translation:
朱佛－烏普即萬有…… 無所不在，不斷擴展， 將非者轉化為朱佛－烏普。
你是非者，必須成為朱佛－ 烏普，否則便歸於虛空。
我們是朱佛－烏普的使者。
我們是邁康。

entries.label: HELLO_SPACE_1
entries.body:
We are part of Juffo-Wup.
Juffo-Wup is the hot light in the darkness.
All else is unfulfilled Void.
The source of Juffo-Wup is at 629.1 : 220.8.
We are the Mycon.
entries.source:
We are part of Juffo-Wup.
Juffo-Wup is the hot light in the darkness.
All else is unfulfilled Void.
The source of Juffo-Wup is at 629.1 : 220.8.
We are the Mycon.
entries.translation:
我們是朱佛－烏普的一部 分。
朱佛－烏普是黑暗中的熾熱 光芒。
其餘一切，皆是尚未成就的 虛空。
朱佛－烏普的源頭位於 629.1 : 220.8。
我們是邁康。

entries.label: lets_be_friends
entries.body: Let's be friends.
entries.source: Let's be friends.
entries.translation: 我們交個朋友吧。

entries.label: came_to_homeworld
entries.body: We have come to your homeworld to seek a truce.
entries.source: We have come to your homeworld to seek a truce.
entries.translation: 我們來到你們的母星， 是為了尋求停戰。

entries.label: submit_to_us
entries.body: Heinous fungus! Submit to our will!
entries.source: Heinous fungus! Submit to our will!
entries.translation: 邪惡的真菌！服從我們的意 志！

entries.label: bye_sun_device
entries.body: We'll just be going now.
entries.source: We'll just be going now.
entries.translation: 我們這就離開。

entries.label: GOODBYE_SUN_DEVICE
entries.body: You are the Non. You must go now, and never return.
entries.source: You are the Non. You must go now, and never return.
entries.translation: 你就是非者。你必須立刻離 開，永不返回。

entries.label: RESPONSE_1
entries.body: This is good.
entries.source: This is good.
entries.translation: 很好。

entries.label: RESPONSE_2
entries.body: This is good.
entries.source: This is good.
entries.translation: 很好。

entries.label: RESPONSE_3
entries.body: This is good.
entries.source: This is good.
entries.translation: 很好。

entries.label: clue_1
entries.body: Its air is pure and sweet.
entries.source: Its air is pure and sweet.
entries.translation: 那裡的空氣純淨甘甜。

entries.label: clue_2
entries.body: Abundant life covers its surface.
entries.source: Abundant life covers its surface.
entries.translation: 豐盛的生命覆滿其表面。

entries.label: clue_3
entries.body: The sun gently warms the surface.
entries.source: The sun gently warms the surface.
entries.translation: 陽光溫柔地暖照地表。

entries.label: what_about_shattered
entries.body: Why are the Shattered Worlds found only in your region of space?
entries.source: Why are the Shattered Worlds found only in your region of space?
entries.translation: 為何破碎世界只出現在你們 這片太空區域？

entries.label: ABOUT_SHATTERED
entries.body: These are the homes of the Deep Children.
entries.source: These are the homes of the Deep Children.
entries.translation: 這些是深淵之子的家園。

entries.label: HELLO_SUN_DEVICE_WORLD_1
entries.body:
This is a special place
filled with Juffo-Wup.
But it is not the source.
Juffo-Wup springs forth from 629.1 : 220.8.
We must not allow this place to be soiled by the Non.
You must go. Now.
entries.source:
This is a special place
filled with Juffo-Wup.
But it is not the source.
Juffo-Wup springs forth from 629.1 : 220.8.
We must not allow this place to be soiled by the Non.
You must go. Now.
entries.translation:
這是特別的地方
其中充盈著朱佛－烏普。
但這裡不是源頭。
朱佛－烏普自 629.1 : 220.8 湧出。
我們絕不容許非者玷汙此 地。
你必須離開。現在。

entries.label: HELLO_SUN_DEVICE_WORLD_2
entries.body:
You have returned to our special place.
This is not permissible.
Leave.
entries.source:
You have returned to our special place.
This is not permissible.
Leave.
entries.translation:
你又回到了我們的特別之 地。
此舉不被允許。
離開。

entries.label: whats_up_sun_device
entries.body: What makes this world so special to you?
entries.source: What makes this world so special to you?
entries.translation: 這個世界為何對你們如此特 別？

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_SUN_DEVICE
entries.body:
Juffo-Wup is the power of life... hot warmth in the cold Void. 
It flows through all things, binding them together, making them one.
You are Non-Juffo-Wup, you cannot understand.
Below is the pod of Juffo-Wup -- there for a thousand centuries.
When we are cold, the pod opens and warms us.
When it is dark, the pod clenches and lo, there is light.
You are the Non. The pod is not for you. You must leave.
entries.source:
Juffo-Wup is the power of life... hot warmth in the cold Void. 
It flows through all things, binding them together, making them one.
You are Non-Juffo-Wup, you cannot understand.
Below is the pod of Juffo-Wup -- there for a thousand centuries.
When we are cold, the pod opens and warms us.
When it is dark, the pod clenches and lo, there is light.
You are the Non. The pod is not for you. You must leave.
entries.translation:
朱佛－烏普是生命之力…… 是冰冷虛空中的熾熱暖意。 
它流過萬物，將萬物繫於一 體，使其合而為一。
你是非朱佛－烏普， 無法理解。
下方是朱佛－烏普之莢—— 已在那裡存在十萬年。
我們寒冷時，莢便張開， 溫暖我們。
黑暗降臨時，莢便緊握； 看哪，光出現了。
你就是非者。莢不屬於你。 你必須離開。

entries.label: like_to_land
entries.body: I have business on this world.  Move aside.
entries.source: I have business on this world.  Move aside.
entries.translation: 我在這個世界有事要辦。  讓開。

entries.label: NEVER_LET_LAND
entries.body:
Juffo-Wup flows through Time and Space. It cannot be stopped by mere energy blasts.
However, you are Non -- not part of Juffo-Wup.
You CAN be destroyed by energy blasts.
Let us demonstrate.
entries.source:
Juffo-Wup flows through Time and Space. It cannot be stopped by mere energy blasts.
However, you are Non -- not part of Juffo-Wup.
You CAN be destroyed by energy blasts.
Let us demonstrate.
entries.translation:
朱佛－烏普流經時間與空 間。區區能量爆破無法阻擋 它。
然而，你是非者——並非朱 佛－烏普的一部分。
能量爆破確實能摧毀你。
且讓我們示範。

entries.label: bye_homeworld
entries.body: Goodbye fungus-boys!
entries.source: Goodbye fungus-boys!
entries.translation: 再見啦，真菌小子！

entries.label: i_have_a_cunning_plan
entries.body: There is a world at the star Organon. I believe it is perfect for your Deep Children.
entries.source: There is a world at the star Organon. I believe it is perfect for your Deep Children.
entries.translation: Organon 星有個世界。我相信那裡非 常適合你們的深淵之子。

entries.label: DIE_LIAR
entries.body:
You are an obstruction to Juffo-Wup.
You must be removed.
entries.source:
You are an obstruction to Juffo-Wup.
You must be removed.
entries.translation:
你是朱佛－烏普的障礙。
你必須被清除。

entries.label: how_goes_implanting
entries.body: Have you visited the planet I told you about?
entries.source: Have you visited the planet I told you about?
entries.translation: 你們去過我提到的那顆行星 了嗎？

entries.label: UNFORSEEN_DELAYS
entries.body:
We have experienced unforeseen delays implanting Deep Children beneath the crust of Organon 1.
However, Juffo-Wup is inevitable.  The Deep Children WILL be born.
entries.source:
We have experienced unforeseen delays implanting Deep Children beneath the crust of Organon 1.
However, Juffo-Wup is inevitable.  The Deep Children WILL be born.
entries.translation:
我們將深淵之子植入 Organon 1 地殼下的作業， 遭遇了無法預見的延誤。
然而，朱佛－烏普無可避 免。  深淵之子必將誕生。

entries.label: DIE_THIEF
entries.body:
You have taken something from us which we value... which is important to Juffo-Wup.
Return the Solar Manipulator immediately.
entries.source:
You have taken something from us which we value... which is important to Juffo-Wup.
Return the Solar Manipulator immediately.
entries.translation:
你拿走了我們珍視之物…… 對朱佛－烏普至關重要之 物。
立刻歸還太陽操控器。

entries.label: DIE_THIEF_AGAIN
entries.body:
You have taken something from us which we value... which is important to Juffo-Wup.
Return the Solar Manipulator immediately.
entries.source:
You have taken something from us which we value... which is important to Juffo-Wup.
Return the Solar Manipulator immediately.
entries.translation:
你拿走了我們珍視之物…… 對朱佛－烏普至關重要之 物。
立刻歸還太陽操控器。

entries.label: GOODBYE_AND_DIE
entries.body:
Juffo-Wup is All
but you are not a part of Juffo-Wup
therefore you must cease existence.
We shall make you cease to exist, for Juffo-Wup.
entries.source:
Juffo-Wup is All
but you are not a part of Juffo-Wup
therefore you must cease existence.
We shall make you cease to exist, for Juffo-Wup.
entries.translation:
朱佛－烏普即萬有
但你並非朱佛－烏普的一部 分
因此你必須停止存在。
為了朱佛－烏普， 我們將使你停止存在。

entries.label: WE_GO_TO_IMPLANT
entries.body:
If your words are true, we will gladly spread Juffo-Wup to a new world!
We will assemble the Birthing Fleet and send them to this planet.
We will send many ships to protect the Children as they grow.
You have been of service to us.
Your insight into the ineffable Juffo-Wup is encouraging.
Perhaps, if we were to plant spore sacs in your brain organ
and let its tendrils spread through your flesh
then you would truly understand Juffo-Wup... become part of Juffo-Wup.
You WOULD be happier and more fulfilled.  Consider our offer.
entries.source:
If your words are true, we will gladly spread Juffo-Wup to a new world!
We will assemble the Birthing Fleet and send them to this planet.
We will send many ships to protect the Children as they grow.
You have been of service to us.
Your insight into the ineffable Juffo-Wup is encouraging.
Perhaps, if we were to plant spore sacs in your brain organ
and let its tendrils spread through your flesh
then you would truly understand Juffo-Wup... become part of Juffo-Wup.
You WOULD be happier and more fulfilled.  Consider our offer.
entries.translation:
若你的話屬實， 我們很樂意將朱佛－烏普擴 展至新世界！
我們將集結誕生艦隊， 派往那顆行星。
我們將派出許多船艦， 在子嗣成長時保護他們。
你為我們提供了服務。
你對不可言喻的朱佛－烏普 所抱持的洞見，令人鼓舞。
也許，只要我們將孢子囊植 入你的腦器官
讓它的卷鬚散布你的血肉
你就能真正理解朱佛－烏 普……成為朱佛－烏普的一 部分。
你必定會更加快樂、 更加圓滿。  考慮一下我們的提議。

entries.label: WONT_FALL_FOR_TRICK
entries.body:
We do not interpret the will of Juffo-Wup.
Only the source is so empowered.
Until instructed otherwise, Juffo-Wup requires that we remain here.
entries.source:
We do not interpret the will of Juffo-Wup.
Only the source is so empowered.
Until instructed otherwise, Juffo-Wup requires that we remain here.
entries.translation:
我們不詮釋朱佛－烏普的意 志。
只有源頭被賦予這項權能。
在收到其他指示前， 朱佛－烏普要求我們留在此 地。
